The '''Dakot system''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dakot Seven]].
